args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent version that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc only achieved health in staging, so it was not a candidate).
2. **Rolled back:** Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — rollout verified.
3. **Verified recovery:** Service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and the recovery status.
